prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC083 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, emotion, palette, spacing, eye-opening shape, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's visible face and hair/head silhouette, warm muted skin, dark eye contours, small muted gray-blue irises, and the existing worried/fearful expression. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and the cell ratio 64:35. Cell order: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT.

Preserve the exact source upper/lower eyelid contours, opening height and width, eye angles, brow positions, and iris size in all cells. The only left/right difference is a gentle one-native-pixel horizontal iris/pupil shift inside each existing aperture. Keep the source's actual muted gray-blue iris color, dark eye outline, and compact pupils fully inside the opening. Half-blink cells retain the same gaze as the open cell above them. Keep visible sclera no broader than the source, in its muted beige/gray tones. Glints should remain tiny and restrained, consistent with the source; no bright white bands. Avoid enlarging eyes or irises, changing the natural asymmetric expression, reshaping lids or brows, square/bar-shaped features, perspective or face redesign, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or added content.
